items.name: -hide_banner
items.summary: Hide the build and library banner.

items.name: -y
items.summary: Overwrite output files without a prompt.

items.name: -n
items.summary: Never overwrite output files.

items.name: -nostdin
items.summary: Disable console input. Use this flag in scripts.

items.name: -vn
items.summary: Disable video output.

items.name: -an
items.summary: Disable audio output.

items.name: -sn
items.summary: Disable subtitle output.

items.name: -shortest
items.summary: Stop when the shortest input stream ends.

items.name: -i
items.summary: Read this input file or stream. You can repeat this option.

items.name: -ss
items.summary: Seek to this time before processing.

items.name: -to
items.summary: Stop at this time.

items.name: -t
items.summary: Limit the output duration in seconds.

items.name: -c
items.summary: Select one encoder for all streams. The value copy does not re-encode.

items.name: -c:v
items.summary: Select the video encoder.

items.name: -c:a
items.summary: Select the audio encoder.

items.name: -preset
items.summary: Set the encoder speed and compression trade-off. The libx264 presets are ultrafast to placebo.

items.name: -crf
items.summary: Set constant rate factor. Lower values keep more quality. The range is 0 to 51.

items.name: -b:v
items.summary: Set the video bitrate.

items.name: -b:a
items.summary: Set the audio bitrate.

items.name: -q:a
items.summary: Set the audio quality for a VBR encoder. Lower values give better quality.

items.name: -q:v
items.summary: Set the video quality for a codec with a quality scale. Lower values give better quality.

items.name: -pix_fmt
items.summary: Set the pixel format. The yuv420p format plays in most browsers.

items.name: -vf
items.summary: Apply a video filter graph.

items.name: -af
items.summary: Apply an audio filter graph.

items.name: -filter_complex
items.summary: Apply a filter graph with multiple inputs or outputs.

items.name: -map
items.summary: Select an input stream for the output. You can repeat this option.

items.name: -map_metadata
items.summary: Copy metadata from an input. The value -1 removes all metadata.

items.name: -movflags
items.summary: Set MP4 muxer flags. The faststart flag moves the index to the file start.

items.name: -frames:v
items.summary: Stop after this number of video frames.

items.name: -loop
items.summary: Set the loop count for the GIF muxer. The value 0 repeats forever.

items.name: -f
items.summary: Force the input or output format.

items.name: -safe
items.summary: Allow unsafe paths in a concat list. The concat demuxer reads this option.

items.name: -avoid_negative_ts
items.summary: Shift timestamps to prevent negative values. Use make_zero with stream copy.

items.name: -ar
items.summary: Set the audio sample rate in hertz.

items.name: -ac
items.summary: Set the number of audio channels.

items.name: -r
items.summary: Set the frame rate.

items.name: -metadata
items.summary: Set one metadata field. You can repeat this option.

items.name: -loglevel
items.summary: Set the log level.

items.name: -threads
items.summary: Set the thread count. The value 0 selects an automatic count.

items.name: -row-mt
items.summary: Enable row-based multithreading in libvpx encoders. The value 1 enables it.
